operation.name: ED50 to WGS 84 (18)
operation.why: Only ED50->WGS 84 operation with area of use covering the central/northern North Sea points (lat 56-58.4, lon -1 to 1.2) and 1 m accuracy; Position Vector

assumptions: Input is ED50 geographic (EPSG:4230), lat/lon order.
notes: A UK-specific ED50 North Sea operation was not in this database; ED50 to WGS 84 (18) used. PROJ default for 4230->4326 would use a different (lower accuracy) operation; not used.
